title: Backend: Add ORM Models for Device Provisioning and Identity
description: Extend backend/models.py with three new SQLAlchemy ORM models to support secure device provisioning, identity management, and enrollment state tracking. DeviceProvisioning stores admin-created bulk provisioning records with hashed bootstrap tokens (never plaintext). DeviceIdentity tracks unique cryptographic identities per device. EnrollmentState is a Python enum (no None values) to avoid ambiguous enrollment state. Reuse existing EnrollmentToken model where it already handles single-use credentials.
steps: Add Python Enum 'EnrollmentState' to backend/models.py with 11 values (NEW, DISCOVERING_CONFIGURATION, CONFIGURATION_FOUND, AUTHENTICATING_DEVICE, ATTESTING_DEVICE, REGISTERING_DEVICE, ENROLLED, CONFIGURING_AGENT, POLICY_DOWNLOADED, ACTIVE) and 6 failure states (CONFIGURATION_NOT_FOUND, AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, ATTESTATION_FAILED, REGISTRATION_FAILED, POLICY_DOWNLOAD_FAILED, NETWORK_ERROR, UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM). Use string values for database compatibility.

Add SQLAlchemy ORM class 'DeviceProvisioning' to backend/models.py with columns: id (PK), organizationId, enrollmentPolicyId, platform (Windows|Android|macOS|iOS), status (ACTIVE|REVOKED), provisioningMethod (AUTOMATIC_ENROLLMENT|QR_ENROLLMENT|MANUAL_CODE), bootstrapTokenHash (String 64, SHA-256, unique), deviceCount, createdAt, expiresAt, lastUsedAt, revokedAt. Add index on bootstrapTokenHash and organizationId.

Add SQLAlchemy ORM class 'DeviceIdentity' to backend/models.py with columns: id (PK), deviceId (String 32, unique, format DG-DEVICE-XXXXXXXX), platform, publicKey (Text, PEM-encoded), attestationData (JSON, nullable), enrollmentCode (String 16, unique, format DG-XXXX-XXXX), createdAt. Add indexes on deviceId and enrollmentCode.

Update existing 'Device' model in backend/models.py to add optional columns: publicKeyFingerprint (String 64), attestationStatus (String 32, default 'PENDING'), identityProvidedBy (String 32), cryptoAlgorithm (String 32, default 'RSA-2048'). No data migration needed—columns will be NULL for existing devices.

Create SQLite safe-migration code in backend/database.py init_db() function (following existing pattern) to add DeviceProvisioning and DeviceIdentity tables if missing. Use ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for existing tables, with IF NOT EXISTS checks to prevent errors on re-runs.
Add docstrings to all new classes explaining the security model (hashed tokens, no plaintext storage, one-time-use credentials, cryptographic attestation where available).
acceptance_criteria: backend/models.py defines EnrollmentState enum with all 17 values and string values
DeviceProvisioning model persists to SQLite with correct schema
DeviceIdentity model persists to SQLite with correct schema
Device model adds new optional columns without breaking existing data
backend/database.py init_db() creates tables and handles migrations safely
All models have appropriate indexes on frequently-queried columns
No plaintext tokens in any model field
verification: Run: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -k model
Run: cd backend && python -c 'from database import init_db; from models import EnrollmentState, DeviceProvisioning, DeviceIdentity; init_db(); print("Models OK")'
Inspect backend/dataghost.db schema: sqlite3 dataghost.db '.schema device_provisioning' and '.schema device_identity' should show all columns
Verify existing Device table not corrupted: sqlite3 dataghost.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM devices' should return a number >= 0
findings: All models implemented successfully. EnrollmentState enum created with 17 values (10 success + 7 failure states). DeviceProvisioning and DeviceIdentity models added with proper security documentation. Device model extended with 4 new optional columns for enrollment system integration. Database migration code updated to safely create new tables and columns without corrupting existing data. All 116 backend tests pass (excluding pre-existing firebase_auth failures). Schema verified in SQLite database with all columns and indexes present.
